architecture.rationale: Agents must not gather lot data by holding the mouse in the screen-edge pan band and then leave it there while coding. Host owns bounded camera steps that always end at SAFE_CURSOR_REST; PrintWindow capture + lot-model observe are preferred over edge scrolling.

CAPTURE_ONLY.note: PrintWindow observe without moving camera or parking edge.

RIGHT_DRAG_BOUNDED.note: Bounded right-drag pan from interior point; must end with SAFE_REST.

WHEEL_ZOOM_BOUNDED.note: Wheel zoom at interior point; must end with SAFE_REST.

SAFE_CURSOR_REST.note: Mandatory terminal park outside the edge band after any camera step.

EDGE_MOUSE_PARK.note: Leaving the cursor in the edge pan band; camera keeps drifting.

CONTINUOUS_EDGE_HOLD.note: Holding edge scroll to scan while planning/coding.

IN_FRAME_WALK_THRASH.note: Do not substitute Sim walking for camera/lot travel.
